dedupe_keys.name: potential command areas of irrigation dams built since 2000

description: This dataset delineates the potential command areas of 441 major irrigation reservoirs established worldwide since 2000, that is, the land that could be irrigated with their water. Georeferenced information on the dams, including height and reservoir capacity, is combined with elevation data to outline each reservoir, and command areas are estimated from the lift that several classes of irrigation pumps can deliver. The aim is to test whether irrigation has actually expanded around new irrigation dams. It was produced at the University of Delaware and published on Zenodo (version 1, August 2024) as three zipped shapefiles under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: command areas are potential, not observed, and depend on the assumed pump classes and elevation data. Simulation uses: estimating the service area of irrigation reservoirs for capacity planning of irrigation schemes. Related record: GeoDAR (data-geodar-georeferenced-global-dams-reservoirs).
